decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core pipeline component business in a growing market, this product likely meets or stays near aspiration levels and is worth retaining given the firm's expansion-oriented capabilities.

Although somewhat more uncertain than the firm's core fittings, this bracket product still builds on existing fabrication competences and the firm likely has enough slack to keep it while demand and fit are tested.

This product is closely related to the firm's established infrastructure applications and production resources, so with no clear sign of underperformance management would be more likely to keep than drop it.
